typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all headings. Never use Inter for headings. Keep leading tight on headings and loose on body. Apply fonts in global CSS or Tailwind config.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Implement both light and dark modes. Default to system preference with a toggle. Use high contrast borders. Dark mode uses deep obsidian (#0A0A0A) never pure black. Avoid teal green or purple for AI elements, use primary blue. Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers.

surfaces: The Grid Borders: Use for Data-heavy sections (Brain View, Task Board). Expose the skeleton with subtle borders on right and bottom of grid items.
Glassmorphism (The Crystal): Use for sticky top navigation bar and floating pills. Light mode: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/40. Dark mode: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10.
The Tracing Beam: Use for Specialist Agents panel cards to show active 'running' state.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct shadows for floating elements. Mostly flat surfaces with sharp 1px borders in the dashboard to maintain Swiss style.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Subtle roundness. max 8px (rounded-md) for cards and widgets. Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for the model picker and tags.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_layout: Collapsible left sidebar for navigation. Top sticky header with Glassmorphism for Model Picker Pill and Notifications. Main content area with generous padding (p-6 to p-12).
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Mode B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap (gap-4 or gap-6). Use for Brain View and Specialist Agents.
grids_and_layouts.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all grid items are direct children of grid containers. Mobile-first responsive always. Use padding heavily for visual separation.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp rounded-md with hover states (translate-y-[-1px] and slight shadow). Must have active focus states.
components.cards: Cardless or flat rectangular with 1px border. Do not overuse shadows on cards.
components.navigation: Sidebar must have icons. Top nav must have model picker.
components.model_picker: Pill-shaped dropdown in top nav. Glassmorphism effect.
components.task_board: Kanban or timeline style list. Left-aligned text. Agent avatars next to tasks.
components.blog_editor: Block-based rich text editor look. Clean, minimal, no messy toolbars.
components.add_blog_system: Code snippet display block with 'Copy' button. Monospace font.
components.public_blog_page: Marketing quality. Swiss minimalist. Huge H1 heading. Large hero image with 30-50% overlay if text is on top.

motion.instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion for micro-interactions. Hover states on cards (translate-y-1). Staggered entrance animations for task lists. Never use 'transition: all'. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure APCA contrast standards. Large text min 3:1, normal text min 4.5:1. Explicit hover and focus states for all interactive elements. Add aria-hidden to decorative elements. CRITICAL: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.

user_avatar.description: User profile avatar in top nav and author avatar in blog

brain_background.description: Abstract visualization for Brain View hero/header

public_blog_hero.description: Hero image for public blog article

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid AI slop aesthetic.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth with z-index hierarchy.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use subtle grain textures, custom cursors, loading animations.
Use sonner for toasts. IMPORTANT: you have .js files not .tsx files, so use `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js`.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
